items.title: SOP-Bench: A new benchmark for evaluating AI agents on real business procedures
items.summary: A standard operating procedure, or SOP, is the written set of steps an organization follows to correctly complete an important piece of routine work the same way every time. Almost every industry runs on SOPs.
